index.title: General
index.description: This machine's name, its keys and the setup wizard.

openRouter.title: OpenRouter
openRouter.description: The key used for cloud-assisted detection.

page.title: Chute aiming
page.description: If the chute points at the wrong bin, run the calibration below. Otherwise the defaults are already right and you can leave this page.
page.loadError: Failed to load chute aiming settings

jogPad.keyboardHint: The arrow keys work too: up and down move {fine}°, left and right {coarse}°. Hold one to repeat.
jogPad.binsInSectionHelp: How many bins the section you are measuring has. More is more accurate; 3 or 5 is best.

steps.firstBin: Aim at the first bin of a section
steps.lastBin: Aim at the last bin of that section

activeParams.title: Active aiming parameters
activeParams.editWarning: The calibration sets these. Only change them by hand if you know exactly what they mean.

calibration.title: Run the calibration
calibration.description: It finds two numbers: the width of a section in degrees, and the offset of the first section from home. From those the machine works out where every bin sits and which ones each layout can reach.
calibration.travelWarning: Every step here moves the chute. It hits a hard stop at home and can never cross it, so it has about {deg}° of travel. Always home first.

step2.description: Pick any layer, and a section you can see whole with more than 2 bins; 3 or 5 is best, and more bins is more accurate. Set its bin count, then jog until the chute points straight into the first bin, and capture.

step3.description: Jog until the chute points straight into the last bin of the same section, then capture. It sits at a higher angle than the first bin.

step4.orderWrong: The last bin must be at a higher angle than the first. Capture the last bin again, jogging so the angle goes up.
step4.locked: Capture both bins to work out the geometry and lock it in.
step4.lockInButton: Work it out and lock it in

saved.title: Saved calibrations
saved.empty: None yet. Run the calibration above to save one.

reachable.title: Reachable bins by layout
reachable.description: Chute travel 0 to {max}°, with a {wedge}° no-go wedge at home.
reachable.explanation: Each layout shows where the chute points for that many bins a section. Bins crossed out in red fall in the wedge between the end of travel ({max}°) and home (0°), which is what loses bins whenever home does not land on a pillar. Click a reachable bin to test-aim at it.
reachable.prompt: Click a bin in any layout to choose it, then test-aim.

binLayoutViz.binsASection: {count, plural, one {# bin a section} other {# bins a section}}
binLayoutViz.wedgeWarning: {count, plural, one {# bin falls} other {# bins fall}} in the {deg}° no-go wedge by home.

page.title: Chute
page.description: Move the chute's stepper by hand, home it, and set its driver.

stallguard.title: Chute StallGuard
stallguard.description: Stop the machine when the chute stalls. Tune it by hand in the steps, or let it tune itself.

stallguard.title: Classification channel StallGuard
stallguard.description: Stop the machine when the classification channel's stepper stalls. Follow the steps to tune how sensitive it is.

controlBoard.title: Control board
controlBoard.description: The machine's control boards and their firmware.

cycleTime.title: Cycle time
cycleTime.description: Where each piece's seconds go on the classification channel: its own work, and its waits for the feeder.

phases.headReady: Waiting for the piece ahead (classified, chute aimed)
phases.turn: Turn (eject the piece ahead, stage this one)

c4Panel.title: C4's own work
c4Panel.description: From the moment a piece lands until C4 asks for the next one.

waitPanel.title: Waiting for the feeder
waitPanel.description: Each wait, by where C3's next piece was when C4 asked. Moving is the share of the wait C3 (or the chute) was turning.

where.onlyOutOfView: Only out of view on C3
where.noneOnC3SomeOnC2: None on C3, some on C2

heldPieces.title: Pieces C2 or C3 could not move
heldPieces.description: Its channel turned under it and it stayed put, so the channel next to it was turned. After three turns the feeder gives up and sorts around it.
heldPieces.gaveUpSuffix: , after the feeder gave up on it

index.title: Data
index.description: What this sorter shares with each Hive, how it captures samples, and what it keeps here.

sampleCapture.title: Sample capture
sampleCapture.description: Camera frames taken while the machine sorts, to train detection. Changes nothing about sorting.

page.title: Training runs
page.description: Runs that label every piece the machine sees with the colors you feed it, for training color recognition. The machine sorts as usual, and the runs go to Hive with the pieces.

trainingMode.label: Training mode
trainingMode.help: While it is on, the dashboard shows the training run in place of Recent pieces. Turning it off ends the run.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: What a run labels its pieces with.

bin.label: Bin
bin.help: Every piece goes to this bin while training mode is on, and the chute stays there. None: pieces go where the sorting profile sends them.
bin.defaultHelp: Route pieces by the sorting profile again.

color.label: Color
color.help: The color being fed. Picking another while a run is open starts a new segment of it, at once.

run.label: Run
run.collectingHelp: Collecting since {since}: {pieces} pieces in {segments, plural, one {# segment} other {# segments}}.
run.idleHelp: A run collects every piece the machine sees until you end it, across pauses.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Newest first. Open a run to see its pieces and exclude any that are wrong.
runs.empty: No runs yet. Pick a color and start one above.

empty.disagree: No piece disagrees with the machine.

trainingDetail.title: Training run
trainingDetail.description: Every piece the machine saw during this run, labeled with the color of its segment. Click a piece to exclude it, and again to bring it back.
trainingDetail.runSummaryOngoing: {from} to now. {segments, plural, one {# segment} other {# segments}}, {pieces} pieces, {labeled} labeled, {excludedCount} excluded.
trainingDetail.runSummaryEnded: {from} to {to}, {duration}. {segments, plural, one {# segment} other {# segments}}, {pieces} pieces, {labeled} labeled, {excludedCount} excluded.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.description: What this sorter has sent to a Hive, what is waiting to go, and what will never be sent.

noHive.title: No Hive is connected
noHive.description: Connect this sorter to a Hive and its uploads are counted here.

unreachableAlert.title: {name} can't be reached
unreachableAlert.body: Nothing is being sent to it. What is waiting stays on this machine until it answers.

uploads.budgetLine: Uploads wait for room under a limit of {budget}.
uploads.notUploadedExplainer: Not uploaded is what was skipped to keep up, or deleted here before it was sent.
uploads.budgetText: {megabytes} MB and {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} a minute

uploadedPanel.title: Uploaded
uploadedPanel.description: Bytes sent to {name} each hour, by kind. Point at an hour for its numbers.
uploadedPanel.empty: Nothing was uploaded in this time.

waitingPanel.title: Waiting to upload
waitingPanel.description: Items waiting at the end of each hour. A mark along the bottom is an hour when some were skipped or deleted before they could be sent.
waitingPanel.empty: Nothing was waiting in this time.

page.title: Hive
page.description: Pair this sorter with a Hive, and choose which ones it sends samples to. What each one receives is set in Data.

models.title: Local models
models.description: Which neural-network model the sorter uses for live detection. A new machine downloads Hive's default model for its hardware and uses it on every channel until you choose another one here.

compatibility.title: Compatibility and speed
compatibility.description: For each model format, which inference backends this machine can run, and how fast they should be on the chosen model.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: What the machine does when something goes wrong mid-sort: ignore it, wait for someone, or recover by itself where it can.
